title: Orthogonalized task-vector Mirror superposition
hypothesis: A compact task address can retrieve correlated task deltas from a shared superposition with lower interference and fewer serialized bytes than independent task deltas; an ordinary orthogonal basis may explain any gain.
physical_object: one shared tensor encoding N linear task deltas

development.selection_metric: query NRMSE, off-diagonal task interference, serialized payload bytes

storage.authority: actual serialized payload bytes including address/basis and metadata

success_gate: Address-bound method has query NRMSE <=0.05 and at least 30% fewer bytes than raw independent deltas, with lower interference than unbound sum.
failure_gate: Address-bound method fails query NRMSE <=0.20 or does not reduce bytes versus raw; generic basis matching Mirror means no Mirror-specific finding.
boundaries: Task count is not independent capacity
Generic orthogonal basis and PSP are controls
